title: Jay Stratton Describes Alleged 2005 Nuclear-Silo UAP Video and DIA Investigation History
summary: In an October 18 interview, former UAP Task Force director Jay Stratton described footage he says he viewed depicting a triangular object near a nuclear missile silo and discussed the origins of government UAP investigations. The recording documents his statements, not independent verification of the alleged footage or programs.
